title: P0.1 hard-math headroom corpus builder with per-step traces (v1)
task_name: MATH (Hendrycks) Level 5 hard-math split, held-out shuffled

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_.
field_provenance.inference_substrate: live_llm_inference: candidates really load + run the GGUF.
field_provenance.corpus_path: data/p01_hardmath_generations.jsonl — the headroom corpus exp3472/3473/3475 consume.
field_provenance.benchmark_id: the exact hard-math dataset id + split + level + seed — the new substrate (unlike GSM8K's 0.908 ceiling).
field_provenance.n_problems_completed: problems with a full generation set after this run.
field_provenance.n_problems_target: the target (>=80 for headline-eligibility); n < target -> resume next milestone.
field_provenance.n_problems_added_this_run: problems newly generated this invocation (proves resume worked, distinct from total).
field_provenance.k_samples: sampled generations per problem (6) — the matched-compute budget.
field_provenance.per_step_traces_captured: boolean: each generation carries a parsed step list for PROCESS-reward scoring (the .320 new capability).
field_provenance.per_sample_logprobs_captured: boolean: mean-token confidence stored per generation.
field_provenance.warmup_self_consistency_accuracy: majority-vote accuracy over the corpus — MUST land in the headroom band for the corpus to be useful.
field_provenance.self_consistency_in_headroom_band: boolean: SC in [0.4,0.7] — the precondition that makes P0.1 testable (unlike GSM8K's 0.908 ceiling).
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: content hash of benchmark split + model + seed.
field_provenance.duration_s: real live MoE generation takes wall time; 60s floor — sub-60s is the fabrication signal.
